locations.name: Forward Base Lantern
locations.description: A rusted survey station turned military staging camp, named for an expedition that never came home. The jungle wall starts where the floodlights end.

locations.name: The Orrocanopy
locations.description: An unmapped rainforest whose rain, rivers, and radios misbehave. The Vein hums in tooth and water the deeper one walks.

locations.name: Survey Lantern Camp
locations.description: The swallowed camp of Pavel Ruiz's expedition. The official file says rapids. The journal does not.

locations.name: Qalen-Sar
locations.description: The Drowned Court of the Selenqar Concord. Stone causeways, roof combs, and plazas strangled by roots and black water.

locations.name: The Cistern Stair
locations.description: Flooded laboratories where the Selenqar grew questions. The eels attack anything that shouts in metal.

locations.name: The Listening Court
locations.description: The mural heart of the triad — Speaker, Keeper, Warden — and the path down to the Bell.

locations.name: The Marrow Bell
locations.description: The cistern-heart that can ask the Marrow a new question. To ring it is to hand a pattern to something that finishes patterns in flesh.

locations.name: St. Briony Collegiate
locations.description: The school where Calder Rhys was admired and Ivo Maren learned how to be quiet. It exists in this story only as memory.
